roles: Full stack and mobile: NestJS, Next.js, React Native, PostgreSQL
summary: I build and run software that moves money, and I do the security work on it myself: threat models, hardening, testing, incident response. Trained in information security first (BSc, 2019 to 2023), learned full-stack and mobile development by shipping. Founder of Devsirch Hub in Nairobi.
aside: Almost all of my work is in private client repositories, so the public repos here are not representative. The activity card includes the private ones.

practices.label: Threat model before code
practices.detail: For anything that handles money or personal data, I write down who could attack it and how before the design is settled, and the design answers each one.

practices.label: Standards, not instinct
practices.detail: OWASP ASVS and the API Security Top 10 for web and services, MASVS and MASTG for mobile, the Kenya Data Protection Act for anything personal. Reviews are run against the list, and findings stay open until the fix is merged and retested.

practices.label: Self-review is labelled as such
practices.detail: I test my own work and say so. An independent penetration test is a different thing, and I tell clients to commission one.

practices.label: Operations are part of security
practices.detail: Every alert has a severity, an owner and a runbook, logs carry no personal data, and backups are restored on a schedule to prove they work.

workflow.label: Design first
workflow.detail: The design is agreed in writing before code. Anything it did not settle is written into the PR as an assumption, so it can be argued with.

workflow.label: Review before merge
workflow.detail: Every change is reviewed before it merges, and the findings are listed in full before anything is filtered out.

workflow.label: Incidents become checks
workflow.detail: After an incident I write down the lesson with the date, and where a script can enforce it, it becomes a CI gate.

workflow.label: Real devices
workflow.detail: A mobile change is tested on a physical phone before it ships, including a cheap one.
